data.name: Paper Trail
data.description: A majordomo is trained to uncover forgeries and trace down discrepancies in paperwork in order to ferret out intrigue. She adds +1 to Linguistics and Profession checks to spot a forgery, deal with paperwork, and notice discrepancies in paperwork. A majordomo who analyzes the handwriting of a document and succeeds at a Linguistics check against a DC equal to 20 + the writer's Bluff bonus gets a hunch about whether the document's writer was lying or otherwise nervous. This ability doesn't work if the document was dictated to someone who thought the contents were legitimate.|max(1,InvestigatorLVL/2)
